verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Claude Design has a 'handoff bundle' that packages a design for Claude Code with a single instruction (claude-design-docs-7, comm-16), but nothing describes a dedicated inspect mode where a developer without an editor seat can click any layer to see measurements, styles, assets, and CSS/iOS/Android code snippets — the classic Figma Dev Mode/Zeplin workflow. The handoff appears to be a one-shot code-generation packet passed to another AI tool, not a persistent layer inspector.
